capabilities: Show an academic CJK character count in the status bar for the whole note
Count characters in the current text selection
Exclude punctuation, numbers, Latin letters, whitespace, frontmatter, and Markdown syntax from the main count
Display reference metrics such as characters with and without whitespace and a Word-like count in a tooltip
Localize the interface in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; installation is by manually copying release files into the plugins folder. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: designed as a supplement to Obsidian's built-in word and character count
problem: Obsidian's built-in word and character count treats all characters alike, so East Asian academic text length cannot be measured the traditional way that excludes punctuation, numbers, Latin text, and whitespace.

relations.evidence: This plugin was inspired in part by CJK Count.

summary: Status bar counter that computes academic character counts for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean writing, for whole notes and selections.
